notes.title: Update 1.2.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We’ve rolled out a new update to improve your gameplay experience, addressing the following issues:
[olist]
Fixed incorrect text in Nicole’s second HCG scene.

Resolved a rare freeze that could occur before store checkout.

Corrected occasional display glitches in Story and CG modes.
[/olist]
Thank you for playing and for all your valuable feedback. We'll keep working to make the game even better!
